name: Window Grid
description: Place the focused window into a grid cell -- or a rectangle spanning several. A hotkey deems the screen a grid (Hyper+9 = 3×3, Hyper+4 = 2×2, Hyper+6 = a 6-cell grid that orients to the screen -- 3×2 wide, 2×3 tall); press a cell to land there, or a second cell down-right of it to fill that rectangle. Pairs with Window Snap and Window Mode.
